parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning set

parameters.name: production_cost
parameters.description: Unit production cost of product $p$ in period $t

parameters.name: unit_volume
parameters.description: Unit storage volume of product $p$ in cubic meters per unit

parameters.name: holding_cost_own
parameters.description: In-house holding cost per cubic meter in period $t

parameters.name: holding_cost_external
parameters.description: External holding cost per cubic meter in period $t

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory of product $p$ at the start of period 0

variables.name: production_plan
variables.description: Quantity of product $p$ produced in period $t$

variables.name: inventory_in_own_warehouse
variables.description: Quantity of product $p$ held in the factory warehouse at the end of period $t$

variables.name: inventory_in_external_storage
variables.description: Quantity of product $p$ held in external storage at the end of period $t$

constraints.name: nonnegative_parameters_and_decision_variables
constraints.description: All demand, costs, volumes, capacities, initial inventory, production quantities, and storage quantities are nonnegative; production and storage quantities are continuous.

constraints.name: full_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: Demand for each product in each period must be fully satisfied with no shortage and no backlogging.
constraints.formula: I_{0,p} + x_{p,1} = d_{p,1} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{ext}} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P\;\text{ and }\; i_{p,t-1}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,t-1}^{\mathrm{ext}} + x_{p,t} = d_{p,t} + i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{ext}} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\; \forall t=2,\dots,T

constraints.name: production_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total production across all products in each period must not exceed the available production capacity.

constraints.name: inventory_flow_consistency
constraints.description: Inventory must propagate consistently across periods using the initial inventory at the start of the planning horizon.
constraints.formula: I_{0,p} + x_{p,1} = d_{p,1} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{ext}} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\;\forall t=1

constraints.name: own_warehouse_capacity_limit
constraints.description: The total volume stored in the factory's own warehouse in any period must not exceed the warehouse capacity.

constraints.name: external_storage_supplementary_use
constraints.description: Any inventory that cannot fit in the factory warehouse may be placed in external storage and is accounted for separately at a higher holding cost.

constraints.name: product_specific_volume_respect
constraints.description: Stored quantities must be consistent with product-specific unit storage volumes when measuring warehouse usage.

constraints.name: fixed_initial_inventory
constraints.description: Initial inventory is fixed and known at the start of the first period.
constraints.formula: I_{0,p} \text{ is fixed for all } p=1,\dots,P

constraints.name: nonnegativity_of_decision_variables
constraints.description: Production and storage quantities must be nonnegative for all products and periods.

constraints.name: inventory_balance_first_period
constraints.description: Inventory flow balance in the first period: initial inventory plus production must cover demand and end-of-period inventory split between own and external storage.
constraints.formula: I_{0,p} + x_{p,1} = d_{p,1} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,1}^{\mathrm{ext}} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P

constraints.name: inventory_balance_later_periods
constraints.description: Inventory flow balance for subsequent periods using prior period ending inventory as the next period starting inventory.
constraints.formula: i_{p,t-1}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,t-1}^{\mathrm{ext}} + x_{p,t} = d_{p,t} + i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{own}} + i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{ext}} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\; \forall t=2,\dots,T

constraints.name: inventory_split_nonnegativity
constraints.description: External storage represents the excess inventory beyond the own warehouse allocation and is modeled as an additional nonnegative inventory channel.

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total cost consisting of production cost plus inventory holding cost in own warehouse and external storage while meeting demand and respecting capacities

final_objective.description: Minimize total production cost plus total holding cost in own warehouse and external storage over all products and periods.
final_objective.formula: \sum_{p=1}^{P}\sum_{t=1}^{T} c_{p,t} x_{p,t} + \sum_{p=1}^{P}\sum_{t=1}^{T} h_t^{\mathrm{own}} v_p i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{own}} + \sum_{p=1}^{P}\sum_{t=1}^{T} h_t^{\mathrm{ext}} v_p i_{p,t}^{\mathrm{ext}}
